summary: The Nifty is consolidating above 22,500 after pulling back from its morning high, keeping a modest gain as buying stays selective ahead of the RBI decision.

detail.leaders: Bajaj Finance, Tata Motors PV, ITC, PSU banks
detail.tone: The market steadied after the late-morning pullback; dips toward 22,460 found buyers, so the rebound is intact if subdued.

top.title: Rebound follows longest losing run in 25 years
top.line: Eight straight weekly falls cut the Nifty 8.7% and the Sensex 8.4% before today's bounce
more: Upbeat Asian markets, Friday's Wall Street gains and easing oil drove the open
Whether the bounce sticks hinges on the RBI decision on Oct 7

top.title: India VIX drops nearly 7%
top.line: Volatility is easing sharply after last week's spike as rate-hike fears cool
more: The VIX had jumped about 16% during Thursday's sell-off
The decline came as the Nifty reclaimed 22,500

top.title: Tata Motors PV rebounds after steep slide
top.line: The stock is up about 1.25% today but remains down 17.6% over three months
more: It is down 9.1% over the past month
Tata Motors PV is among the top Nifty gainers
